import torch
name = "model.language_model.layers.5.mlp.down_proj.weight"
t = load(name)
b = t.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()
assert torch.equal(b.float(), t)
i = int(t.abs().reshape(-1).argsort()[t.numel() // 2])
bits = b.reshape(-1).view(torch.int16).clone()
bits[i] += 1
new = bits.view(torch.bfloat16).reshape(t.shape).float()
print("entry", i, "of", t.numel(), "from", t.reshape(-1)[i].item(), "to", new.reshape(-1)[i].item(),
      "| entries changed:", int((new != t).sum()))
print(save_edit(name, new))
